description: Shared Renovate preset for the GitHub-canonical meltforce repos (topic claude-pipeline). Consumed via extends: ['github>meltforce/renovate-config']. Updates arrive as PRs and merge through GitHub auto-merge once the repo's required checks pass; the Claude review passes a renovate[bot] PR that touches only dependency files (the repo's REVIEW.md). Forgejo-canonical repos use homelab's default.json instead.

packageRules.description: Majors need the checkbox in the dependency dashboard; a ticked one opens a PR that goes through the same checks and auto-merge.
All npm dependencies of a repo share one package-lock.json; separate branches each rewrite it and then conflict. One PR for every non-major npm update.

Peer ranges couple the Vite toolchain majors (vitest wants a matching vite, @vitejs/plugin-react and vite-plugin-pwa build against the same vite major, jsdom is vitest's DOM environment), and they share the lockfile.
eslint and its plugins declare each other in peer ranges; a lone eslint major fails npm ci.
react-i18next declares a peer range on i18next.

The go directive names the release actions/setup-go installs (go-version-file: go.mod), so govulncheck checks that standard library. go-mod-directive versioning reads `go 1.27.2` as `^1.27.2`, which every 1.x satisfies, so without `bump` the line never moves.
A Go minor moves the go directive and the builder image `golang:1.N-alpine` together; a directive ahead of the builder image fails the build. Checkbox, one branch. Patches merge automatically.
The Node release in a Dockerfile (`node:26.x.y-…`) and in CI (`node-version` of actions/setup-node) carry one version; one PR raises both.
A Python minor changes the interpreter under every dependency; it needs the checkbox like a major.
